messages:
ashley: Heads up — Lumenix flagged invoice INV-4521 (2026-03-14). They ran a sandbox stress test that looks like ~1.2M tokens in a short burst and surge charges kicked in. Customer is asking for a goodwill waiver of the prorated surge amount: $12,300. I have their support screenshot and email thread.

omar: Can you confirm the usage window and whether the traffic hit Dedicated or Hosted? If it hit Hosted and was untagged, it might be counted as prod.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-4521 snapshot: total $15,430. Surge charges: $12,300 (3/14 02:10–02:25 UTC). Account tier: self-serve. Usage tags: customer=Lumenix, env=sandbox (customer-supplied). Resource: hosted/gpt-large

nora: CS validated — customer says they were running internal sandbox tests and didn’t expect production surge billing. They asked for a one-time waiver as a customer-retention gesture. Anything blocking us from approving an exception >$10k?

kevin: Policy note: manual adjustments > $10k need Director signoff. Also need GL code for bookkeeping and the adjustment reason for audit trails.

ashley: GL code is 4-5220 (Billing adjustments). I'll prepare the adjustment ticket. Planned patch payload:
```
PATCH /finance/adjustments
{
  "account": "acct_LUMX",
  "invoice": "INV-4521",
  "amount": -12300,
  "reason": "goodwill - sandbox surge (one-time)"
}
```

mira: Approve one-time goodwill waiver of $12,300 for Lumenix. Please include 'exception: sandbox test' and attach the customer's email thread to the ticket. cc @kevin for GL posting.

kevin: Thanks Mira. Once the ticket is created, route to billing-ops queue and I'll post the journal entry to 4-5220 and mark it in month-end close doc (sheet: "Mar 2026 adjustments").

ashley: :thumbsup: I'll open FIN-2489 with the payload above, attach emails and the invoice screenshot, and wait for the billing-ops confirmation before applying the reversal.

mira: For audit note please add: "Approved by Head of Finance for customer retention; one-time exception; not a policy change." Keep that in the Jira ticket.

nora: I'll notify Lumenix once the credit posts and remind them about tagging sandbox traffic (env=sandbox) to avoid future accidental billable bursts.
